highlights.text: Developing scalable web applications and core features across the stack using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL for meal ordering and management workflows.
Building robust RESTful API endpoints and backend services, implementing authentication, business logic validation, and optimizing database queries for high reliability.
Crafting intuitive, responsive user interfaces and modular dashboard components, ensuring fast page load times and seamless user experience.
Writing clean, maintainable code, conducting testing, and collaborating with cross-functional team members in an Agile environment to deliver product features.
Built core UI in React.js and Next.js, increasing user engagement by 35% and cutting navigation time by 25% for 10,000+ daily user interactions.

Designed business logic and REST APIs with Node.js, Express.js, and Prisma; added Redis caching and JWT-based role-based access control (RBAC), reducing API response times to 0.5–1.5s and database load by 60%.
Secured 20+ endpoints with authentication/authorization, deployed production apps on AWS through CI/CD pipelines, and wrote unit and integration tests to reduce regressions.
Took part in code reviews and pair programming within an Agile team, and worked across TypeScript, Bun, and PostgreSQL on performance optimization initiatives.
